about: Container images for bin/run-shard.mjs, pinned by the digest of the multi-platform index. node24: every helper (static reader, analyser, HTTP probe, egress proxy) and npm targets; node22: npm targets that ask for it; node24-build and node22-build: the install of an npm target with install_scripts, so a native module can compile (the full Debian image of the very same Node release as node24 and node22, 24.22.3 and 22.23.5: compilers, make, python3 and the Node headers in /usr/local, so the ABI and glibc match the slim image the server then runs in); python: PyPI targets (venv + pip); go: `go install` only (the built binary runs in node24). Recorded 18 Nov 2026 (the build images 24 Nov 2026); change only by a reviewed commit. rust-build: the Rust toolchain (rust:1.99.1-bookworm, the full Debian 12 image: cc, make, pkg-config and the OpenSSL headers a build script may need) for `cargo install` of a crate, which then runs in the same image (the libraries it linked against); the same digest as isokron-ai/mcp-writecheck-action loop/images.json. dotnet-sdk: the .NET 10 SDK (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0.404-noble, Ubuntu 24.04) for `dotnet tool install` of a NuGet tool package, which then runs on its runtime. Both recorded 25 Nov 2026.
